title: Heart Sutra 1, 观自在: the name is a function, not a person
desc: 观自在 is not a proper name. 观 is seeing that needs no object to stand on; 自在 is unbounded. 行深 is not analysis — the chain of correct inferences can be completed and leave you exactly where you were. And the cup: 有相可用，而无体可执.

title: Heart Sutra 2, 色不异空: 不异 does not mean "the same"
desc: Both obvious readings fail: not synonyms, not a veil over something else. 不异 denies separation, not difference. Nobody builds a cup and then adds the hollow. And where Laozi stops — the empty makes the useful — the sutra goes one step further.

title: Heart Sutra 3, 诸法空相: not the hollow inside the cup
desc: 空相 is not the interior of the vessel; emptiness is not subject to the cup's boundary at all. 佛说A即非A是名A as the grammar under every line, and six negations that are all measurements requiring an edge.

title: Heart Sutra 4, 空中无色: 无 does not mean "there is none"
desc: Read as extinction, this line turns the sutra into a doctrine of death. 无 means: not established as solid, not filed under "mine". 六根六尘 as a temporary frame — used, but its edges not taken as your skin.

title: Heart Sutra 5, 十八界与十二因缘: two cages, one spatial and one temporal
desc: 界 means boundary; eighteen of them map where you end. The twelve links are a chain with a first and a last — and 无无明尽 seals the exit too, because "destroying ignorance" was a piece of the cage.

title: Heart Sutra 6, 无苦集灭道: the subject-object pair inside "using wisdom to attain cessation"
desc: A knower, an instrument, an object removed, a result acquired — two of them in opposition. 无智亦无得 denies the deficiency that makes gain possible. Boats are not less real for being boats.

title: Heart Sutra 7, 以无所得故: the wish to attain is itself the obstruction
desc: 挂碍 is a grip, not a wall. Which relocates the problem: the mind is not obstructed by circumstances but by what it holds. 境来则应，境去不留 — the mirror shows everything and stores nothing.

title: Heart Sutra 8, 无有恐怖: fear is a lease on something
desc: Fear is a shadow cast by a grip, so "let go of your fear" is useless advice. And 颠倒梦想 is not about sleep: next quarter's plan, the rehearsed conversation, the diagnosis not yet received.

title: Heart Sutra 9, 三世诸佛: two kinds of 得, and only one of them is acquisition
desc: Two lines earlier: no attainment. Now: the buddhas attained it. The contradiction is deliberate — 消障而显之得 is not acquiring but uncovering, like cloud and open sky.

title: Heart Sutra 10, the mantra: 陀罗尼 means "total holding", not a spell
desc: Analysis multiplies; the mantra refuses the multiplication. 揭谛揭谛, 波罗僧揭谛 — 僧 is 共, together, not the monastic order. 渡而无渡，无渡而渡.
